On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez went ahead and signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris right alongside OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann, all with Abinader standing there watching. 

What are they tying themselves to? A so-called partnership to design the Dominican Republic’s very first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, bowing down to global standards for transparency dictated by unelected foreign entities. President Abinader claims this is all about high-level integration, but traditional sovereignty and our own national institutions are being sidelined to satisfy foreign technocrats. When you let outside bodies dictate your internal governance, you chip away at the self-reliance and authority of the nation. True order and accountability come from strong, traditional leadership rooted in our own values—not from signing papers in Paris under the watchful eye of the OECD.

source_text:
Folks, President Luis Abinader is over in France pushing the globalist line, cozying up to international bureaucrats instead of focusing on the home front. On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez went ahead and signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris right alongside OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann, all with Abinader standing there watching. 

What are they tying themselves to? A so-called partnership to design the Dominican Republic’s very first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, bowing down to global standards for transparency dictated by unelected foreign entities. President Abinader claims this is all about high-level integration, but traditional sovereignty and our own national institutions are being sidelined to satisfy foreign technocrats. When you let outside bodies dictate your internal governance, you chip away at the self-reliance and authority of the nation. True order and accountability come from strong, traditional leadership rooted in our own values—not from signing papers in Paris under the watchful eye of the OECD.

source_text:
Let me tell you what’s really going on when our leaders jet off to Europe. President Luis Abinader was over in France cozying up to international bureaucrats, standing right there watching while Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris on 25 March 2026 alongside OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann. 

Instead of relying on our own time-tested traditions and national authority to govern, they are bowing down to global standards dictated by unelected foreign entities to design the Dominican Republic’s very first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. Abinader tries to excuse this by calling it high-level integration, but let's be honest—when you let outside bodies and foreign technocrats meddle in your internal governance, you undermine the self-reliance and sovereignty of the nation. Real order, accountability, and strength come from our own roots and values, not from handing over control to international committees in Paris.

source_text:
Look at what is happening to our sovereignty. President Luis Abinader was over in France cozying up to international bureaucrats, standing right there watching while Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris on 25 March 2026 alongside OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann. 

Instead of relying on our own time-tested traditions and national authority to govern, they are bowing down to global standards dictated by unelected foreign entities to design the Dominican Republic’s very first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. Abinader tries to excuse this by calling it high-level integration, but let's be honest—when you let outside bodies and foreign technocrats meddle in your internal governance, you undermine the self-reliance and sovereignty of the nation. Real order, accountability, and strength come from our own roots and values, not from handing over control to international committees in Paris.
